name: PricePress – Advanced Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Are you looking for a simple yet powerful way to implement dynamic pricing in your WooCommerce store?
Do you want to encourage customers to buy in larger quantities and increase your average order value?
PricePress is the perfect solution.

PricePress is an intuitive and lightweight plugin that allows you to easily set up advanced, quantity-based pricing rules for your WooCommerce products.
Go beyond a single static price and create sophisticated tiered pricing structures that reward customers for buying in bulk.
This is the ideal tool for setting up volume discounts, simple wholesale pricing, or promotional offers.
With a clean interface integrated directly into the familiar WooCommerce product data panel, you can add dynamic pricing rules and offer powerful free shipping incentives on a per-product basis in just a few clicks.

Features

  • Advanced Tiered Pricing: Create unlimited quantity-based pricing tiers for your products.
    Set a total price for a specific quantity (e.g., 2 for $320), and the plugin handles the rest.
  • Strategic Free Shipping Incentive: Offer free shipping when a customer purchases a specific quantity of an item.
    You can also leave the quantity blank to offer free shipping on any purchase of that product.
  • Per-Unit Price Display: The frontend table automatically calculates and displays the effective price per unit, clearly showing customers the value of buying in bulk (e.g., “$160 per unit”).
  • Optional Frontend Pricing Table: You can choose on a per-product basis whether to display a clean “Volume Discounts” table on the product page to inform and upsell your customers.
  • Smart Cart Notices: The plugin displays dynamic messages in the cart, encouraging users to add more items to unlock free shipping, or congratulating them when they do.
  • Seamless Admin UI: Manage all settings directly within a “PricePress” tab in the familiar WooCommerce product data section.
    No need to learn a new interface.
  • Real-time Validation: Get instant feedback in the admin panel for invalid input like negative numbers or duplicate quantities to prevent errors before they happen.
  • Modern Compatibility: Lightweight, efficient, and fully compliant with modern WooCommerce features like High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

How PricePress Helps Your Business Grow

  • Increase Average Order Value: The core of PricePress is encouraging customers to add more to their cart.
    By showing them clear discounts for buying 3, 5, or 10 items, you can significantly boost your revenue per customer.
  • Boost Sales with Bulk Pricing: Perfect for merchants selling items that are often bought in multiples.
    Set up compelling bulk pricing offers that make larger purchases a great deal for your customers.
  • Clear & Transparent Discounts: You have the option to display a clean “Volume Discounts” table on your product pages.
    This table automatically calculates and shows the price per unit, making the value of the discount completely transparent and encouraging conversions.
  • Reduce Cart Abandonment: Use the free shipping incentive to remove one of the biggest barriers to completing a purchase.
    Offer free shipping when a customer buys a specific quantity of a product, with a clear message in the cart showing them how close they are.

Seamlessly Integrated with WooCommerce

PricePress feels like a native part of your store.
All settings are located in a clean “PricePress” tab within the familiar WooCommerce product edit screen.
There are no complicated global settings pages; you control the dynamic pricing in WooCommerce on a per-product basis.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pricepress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Edit a WooCommerce Simple Product.
  4. Click on the “PricePress” tab in the “Product data” section to configure your discount rules.
sections.faq:
What is meant by dynamic pricing?

Dynamic pricing is a strategy where the price of a product is not fixed, but changes based on certain rules or conditions.
PricePress enables this by changing the price based on the quantity a customer adds to their cart.

Is dynamic pricing good for an ecommerce business?

Yes, absolutely!
Ecommerce dynamic pricing is a powerful strategy to increase revenue.
It allows you to create bulk discounts, reward loyal customers, and run targeted promotions that can significantly increase your average order value.

Can I use this for B2B or wholesale pricing?

PricePress is an excellent tool for setting up simple, product-level B2B dynamic pricing or wholesale-style discounts.

Does this work with variable products?

This version is designed for Simple Products only.
